label: Conway's Life: ConwayLifeSmallWorld
description: Conway's Life on a lattice with Ascape's small-world neighbourhood (Ascape 5.6.1 edu.brook.life.ConwayLifeSmallWorld, a copy of ConwayLife that builds Array2DSmallWorld on a 60 by 60 extent). Array2DSmallWorld takes each cell's Moore neighbours within a radius (default 1) and replaces each, with probability randomEdgeRatio (default 0), by a random cell. The legacy model builds the space with the no-argument constructor, which sets no geometry, so the lattice is not periodic, and it never sets the radius or the ratio: with the defaults this is plain Moore Life on a 60 by 60 lattice with hard edges, which is what is written here, and cells at the edge have fewer neighbours. The coded port exposed the radius and the random edge ratio as parameters, which the legacy model does not; they are left out of this model, since rewiring the neighbourhoods needs a small-world network generator that the format does not have yet (docs/roadmap.md). Cells update synchronously, as in ConwayLife.

initialAliveDensity.label: Initial alive density
initialAliveDensity.description: The portion of cells that are alive when the model starts (the legacy static initialAliveDensity, a float, default 0.1; here a parameter).

build.label: Build
build.description: Builds the lattice, one cell in every site.

cell.label: Cell
cell.description: A site of the lattice (the legacy LifeCell, which defines the state of a cell within the automaton): alive or dead. Alive cells are drawn white and dead cells black, as in the legacy cells.

on.label: Alive
on.description: Whether the cell is alive (the legacy LifeCell.alive; its collector is commented out in the legacy model, and the count of live cells is added here for the chart).

live.label: Live neighbours
live.description: The live neighbours the cell counted in the latest Count rule.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: The legacy LifeCell.initialize: the cell starts alive with the probability of the initial alive density (a draw of a float below the density). Every other cell starts dead.

count.label: Count
count.description: First half of the legacy synchronous rule (the execute of ExecuteThenUpdate, in which a cell reads its neighbours): each cell counts its live neighbours (the legacy countNeighbors with the IS_ALIVE conditional) and keeps the count. No cell changes state here, so the count does not depend on the order cells run in.

neighbors.description: Every neighbouring cell (the eight of a Moore neighbourhood; fewer at an edge that does not wrap) that is alive: each adds one to the count.

update.label: Update
update.description: Second half of the legacy synchronous rule (its update): every cell takes its next state at once, after all have counted. The Life rule (legacy calculateNextAlive): a live cell with fewer than two or more than three live neighbours dies; a dead cell with exactly three comes alive; otherwise nothing changes. Written as: alive with three, or alive with two if it was alive already.

cellStyle.label: Cell Style
cellStyle.description: How a cell is drawn: alive or dead, filling its site.

world.label: Lattice
world.description: A 60 by 60 lattice with a Moore neighbourhood and hard edges (not periodic, since the legacy Array2DSmallWorld is built without a geometry).

width.label: Width
width.description: Number of columns (the legacy bean property width).

height.label: Height
height.description: Number of rows (the legacy bean property height).
